subject: Payment routing discrepancy + VAT posting for CloudNova remits
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Finance Ops <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Revenue Ops <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CloudNova remit — unapplied portion and VAT routing mismatch

Hi team,

Looping you both in — CloudNova has a remittance we applied on 5/31 where ~€24,300 was allocated to a bulk prepayment GL rather than the live-invoice lines. Their remittance shows VAT split across two invoice batches (standard 20% + a 0% export line), but our apply logic routed the entire payment to the unsecured suspense / prepayment ledger.

Impact: AR shows a stale unapplied balance on the prepayment account; VAT liability is overstated in the June VAT window. They also flagged that one of the invoices (CN-1129) is marked paid in their ledger but remains outstanding for us.

Please advise: can Revenue Ops run a targeted apply to invoice lines and Marcus, can Finance accept a reverting JV that reclassifies the prepayment to clearing + corrects VAT GL? I attached the remittance PDF from CloudNova.

Action items I suggest:
- Grace: perform invoice match and attempt reapply (idempotent, snapshot first).
- Marcus: draft JV w/ VAT reversal lines and balancing entries so Tax team can sign off.
- Lauren: confirm whether we need to reopen bank reconciliation for 5/31 (likely yes).

I prefer we avoid write-offs; this looks like a posting/routing bug. If you need me to escalate to Eng or TaxOps, say so.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: remittance_CloudNova_20280531.pdf (pdf, 78KB)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudNova remit — unapplied portion and VAT routing mismatch

Thanks Evelyn — I started a dry run on a copy of the AR ledger this morning. Notes so far:

- I can reproduce the apply mismatch: our parser grouped the remittance by payment reference and picked the 'prepayment' rule because two invoice refs were missing the hyphened suffix we expect (CN-1129 vs CN1129).
- There are three invoice lines: CN-1127 (net 45,000 EUR, 20% VAT), CN-1129 (net 18,000 EUR, 0% VAT export), CN-1130 (net 6,000 EUR, 20% VAT). The remittance shows a single payment for 74,700 EUR (including VAT).
- Proposed next step: run the targeted reapply for the specific payment id, produce a diff, then run the apply in production during a quiet window.

I will produce a match report and include exact payment_id and action log. CC'ing Lauren for reconciliation/GL impacts and Marcus for the JV.

Grace
Revenue Operations

Emily — thanks, that explains the parser mismatch. Grace will run a safe reapply and produce a reconcile file. Marcus / Lauren — tentative plan below; please comment: 

1) Grace runs reapply to allocate the payment id to invoice lines (non-destructive, will create an audit snapshot) — target window: Thu 06/07 23:00 UTC.
2) If reapply succeeds, Marcus to post a corrective JV reversing the prepayment GL (4100) and crediting AR invoices + VAT payable reclassification.
3) Lauren to reopen the bank reconciliation for 5/31 (only the affected deposit) and mark the deposit as matched to the reallocated invoices.
4) Notify CloudNova once CN-1129 is marked paid on our side.

If any of the steps fail we will escalate to Engineering for a parser update and consider an interim manual apply.

Evelyn
